# Advanced Aimbot

Source: [wiki article 2032](../archive/2032.md); edited 2023-12-13.

<a id="wiki-2032-n1"></a>

- Demonstrates separating slower target selection (0.25-second loop) from per-frame facing updates.

<a id="wiki-2032-n2"></a>

- Target selection filters living enemies by LOS/view cone, vulnerability, spawn state, selected defensive abilities, then scores distance from reticle with barrier penalty.

<a id="wiki-2032-n3"></a>

- Projectile leading offsets target eye position by velocity times approximate travel time; arc compensation is a per-hero/per-ability coefficient indexed through parallel global arrays.

<a id="wiki-2032-n4"></a>

- Hero lookup explicitly accounts for Echo duplication and Ramattra alternate form.
